subject: EU session resets and intermittent truncation — service advisory for Novaresearch
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@novaresearch.com>, support@novaresearch.com
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-10T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Advisory: Intermittent session resets and truncated responses in EU region

Hi Alicia —

We wanted to let you know we are investigating reports of intermittent session resets and truncated generation responses affecting customers in our eu-central-1 region. Impact observed: some conversations are receiving short/truncated outputs and clients see 401-style session resets causing mid-response terminations.

What we're doing now:
- Ops bridge opened and we're tracing routing affinity between edge and region routing layer.
- We're collecting logs for affected request IDs (please see attached excerpt with sample request IDs we captured from our edge logs).
- Temporary mitigation: we are steering new traffic to an alternate routing tier while we isolate the root cause.

Immediate customer impact: degraded generation completeness and occasional session resets. No data corruption reported.

I'll keep this thread for operator updates and will follow up with a mitigation ETA within the hour. If you have specific request IDs or timestamps, please reply here so we can correlate.

Apologies for the disruption — we're treating this as priority.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Technical Account Manager
Redwood Inference

We started seeing this around 07:45 UTC; examples attached (screenshot and one truncated response). Our production QA reported ~3% of sessions truncating mid-stream and several clients showing a reconnect loop. One example request id: 8b7f9c2a.

Hannah / Marissa —

Looping you in with customer examples. Ops bridge has identified elevated 502/504 handoffs between the EU edge and regional routing plane; preliminary traces show requests intermittently losing connection affinity, which results in stale session keys at the inference pool and a reset. Steps we need to run:

1) Roll routing tier back to last known-good commit (marissa to coordinate with infra deploy)
2) Short-term steer: continue traffic shift to fallback routing tier (hannah to confirm steer quickly)
3) Collect full request traces for affected request ids (Sean to share sample IDs with ops)
4) Postmortem owner assigned (Hannah) and timeline for customer-facing write-up (end of day).

Please escalate to infra on-call if rollback can't be staged within 20 minutes. Customer is reporting visible impact; recommend offering a short service credit if issue extends past 4 hours.

—Sean

Date: 2026-09-10T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Update: Root cause identified and mitigation deployed — EU session resets

Alicia —

Update and immediate actions completed:

Root cause: A recent change to the regional routing layer introduced a bug in connection affinity bookkeeping under certain header-preservation paths. That bug caused a small percentage of requests to be routed to a different inference pool without transferring session tokens, leading to session resets and truncated responses.

Resolution: We reverted the routing change and rebalanced traffic back to the stable tier at 15:10 UTC. We also applied a fail-safe that rejects mismatched affinity handoffs rather than attempting a cross-pool forward.

Customer impact window: approx 07:40 UTC — 15:10 UTC (partial). Preliminary impact estimate: ~2.5% of EU generation requests experienced truncation or resets during the window.

Next steps and remediation for Novaresearch:
- We recommend a short client-side session refresh after 15:30 UTC to clear any stale tokens; if you prefer, Redwood can send a token-refresh endpoint call (we can coordinate a small maintenance window).
- Postmortem and timeline: Hannah is the postmortem owner; we will publish a customer-facing incident report and a detailed technical postmortem on the status page and shared drive by end of day tomorrow. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-09-10-eu-session-reset
- Credit: We're prepared to offer a targeted credit for affected usage during the window; I'll scope that with finance and send a proposal by EOD.

Again, sorry for the disruption. If you see residual issues after the recommended session refresh, please reply with sample request IDs and we will triage immediately.

Regards,

—Sean Gallagher
Senior Technical Account Manager
Redwood Inference
